spans.s:
शिख (इ) शिङ्खति 1.
a. To go, or
approach.

शिखण्ड (ण्डः) 1.
m. The tail of a pea-
cock; locks left on the crown of
child's head.

शिखण्डक (कः) 1.
m. Idem.

शिखाण्डक (कः) 1.
m. Hair left on
each side of the head.

शिखण्डिक (कः) 1.
m. A cock. 1.
f.
Lock of hair on the crown.

शिखण्डिन् (ण्डी) 5.
m. A peacock; its
tail; a cock; an arrow; a sage.
f. (ई) A jasmine, a shrub.
m. f.
The son or daughter of
Drupada.

शिखर (रः-रं) 1.
m. n. The peak or
summit of a mountain; the top;
end; horripilation; edge of a
sword; arm-pit; ruby. 1.
f. A
plant from which bow-strings
are made.

शिखर-वासिनी (नी) 3.
f. Durgā.

शिखरिन् (री-रिणी-रि) 1.
m. A moun-
tain; a tree; hill fort; lapwing,
f. (ई) A sweet dish of curds; fine
woman; hair across the navel;
name of a metre.
a. Crested,
peaked.

शिखलोहित (तः) 1.
m. A plant,
Cucurmura.

शिखा-तरु (रुः)
m. A candlestick,
lampstand.

शिखा-धर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Crested, hav-
ing a top knot.
m. A peacock; a
Jaina sage.

शिखा-धार (रः) 1.
m. A peacock.

शिखा-मूल (लं) 1.
n. A carrot or
turnip.

शिखावत् (वान्) 5.
m. Agni or fire;
a lamp; personified descending
node.
f. (ई) A plant,
Sanseviera
Zeylanica.

शिखावर (रः) 1.
m. The jack fruit
tree,
Artocarpus integrifolia.

शिखावल (लः-ला-लं)
m. A peacock.
1.
f. Celosia cristata. a. Crested.

शिखा-वृक्ष (क्षः) 1.
m. The stand of a
lamp.

शिखा-वृद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Usurious in-
terest payable daily.

शिखि-ग्रीव (वं) 1.
n. Blue vitriol.

शिखि-ध्वज (जः) 1.
m. Smoke;
Kār-
tikeya.

शिखिन् (खी-खिनी-खि)
m. Fire; pea-
cock; bull; arrow; tree; cock;
descending node; horse; moun-
tain; brāhman; ascetic; lamp.
a. Crested.

शिखि-पुच्छ (च्छं) 1.
n. A peacock's tail.

शिखि-मण्डल (लः) 1.
m. A tree,
Tapia
cratoeva.

शिखि-वर्द्धक (कः) 1.
m. A pumpkin.

शिखि-वाहन (नः) 1.
m. Kārtikeya.

शिखि-शिखा (खा) 1.
f. Flame; crest.

शिखि-शेखर (रं) 1.
n. Peacock's
crest.
